page.overview:
Who is Braum Bourne?

Braum Bourne, also known as "Zakkeg", was a male Mandalorian living during the Cold War. Having been sent their way by Rally Master Merrk Kelborn on Vaiken Spacedock, he and Gen Vizla helped give tips to the future Grand Champion of the Great Hunt, becoming very impressed with the young bounty hunter.

Before the mission's removal from the game, Braum "Zakkeg" Bourne appeared in the video game Star Wars: The Old Republic as part of the Advanced Training mission for the Bounty Hunter class, wherein players were sent to him and Gen Vizla by Rally Master Merrk Kelborn in order to receive advice on whether to learn the skills of either a Powertech or a Mercenary. While Vizla preferred the Mercenary specialization, Bourne advocated for the Powertech specialization. He could be found both on Vaiken Spacedock and in the Mandalorian enclave on Dromund Kaas.
